cat > /tmp/download_mistral_aria2.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/models/Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407-AWQ"
BASE="https://hf-mirror.com/casperhansen/Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407-AWQ/resolve/main"
mkdir -p "$DIR"

# Download small files first
for f in config.json generation_config.json tokenizer.json tokenizer_config.json special_tokens_map.json model.safetensors.index.json quant_config.json; do
  if [ ! -f "$DIR/$f" ] || [ $(stat -c%s "$DIR/$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) -lt 100 ]; then
    aria2c -x 16 -s 16 --timeout=120 --max-tries=3 -d "$DIR" -o "$f" "$BASE/$f" 2>&1 | tail -1 || true
  fi
done
echo "Small files done"

# Download safetensors shards with aria2c (16 connections per file)
for i in $(seq -w 1 14); do
  f="model-000${i}-of-00014.safetensors"
  if [ -f "$DIR/$f" ]; then
    size=$(stat -c%s "$DIR/$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    if [ "$size" -gt 100000000 ]; then
      echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') SKIP $f (exists, $(numfmt --to=iec $size))"
      continue
    fi
  fi
  echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') Downloading $f..."
  aria2c -x 16 -s 16 -k 5M \
    --timeout=300 --max-tries=5 --retry-wait=10 \
    --file-allocation=none \
    -d "$DIR" -o "$f" \
    "$BASE/$f" 2>&1 | grep -E "Download complete|ERROR|ETA" | tail -3
  echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') Done $f ($(stat -c%s "$DIR/$f" 2>/dev/null | numfmt --to=iec || echo '?'))"
done

echo "ALL_DOWNLOAD_COMPLETE"
du -sh "$DIR"
ls "$DIR"/*.safetensors 2>/dev/null | wc -l
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/download_mistral_aria2.sh
echo "Script ready"
